capabilities: Sync Markdown checkbox lines with Todoist tasks in both directions
Set due dates and projects using inline markers and tags
Create, update, complete, and reopen tasks from note lines
Render Todoist filter results as a task list in a code block
Queue edits offline and sync them in the background
extras: Manual installation is described via release downloads or cloning the repo; sync uses a local-first cache with a persistent offline queue.
problem: Obsidian tasks are plain checkboxes with no connection to an external task service, so changes in either place must be made twice.

relations.evidence: lets you manage Todoist tasks in plain text

summary: Two-way Todoist sync that manages tasks as Markdown checkboxes with inline due dates, project tags, and filter-based task list code blocks.
